description: This PHP source file defines an event listener class 'InvestStatusChangerListener' that hooks into the Symfony kernel events to handle investment status changes within the Goteo project. The class responds to controller events, manages session data related to investments, redirects, and displays messages based on investment status and user actions.

classes.name: InvestStatusChangerListener
classes.description: An event listener that manages the state of investments during controller events, handling session updates, redirects, and notifications based on user actions related to investments.

methods.name: onController
methods.description: Handles controller events to manage investment status, perform redirects, and display messages depending on the controller action and current session state.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this listener subscribes to; in this case, the kernel controller event.
